subject.title: ci: defer macOS tests for draft pull requests

question: Should code-changing draft pull requests be allowed to report aggregate-green CI while macOS Swift validation is explicitly deferred?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but the meaning of a green aggregate check is an intentional repository policy choice rather than a correctness question automation can settle.

options.title: Approve Draft Deferral
options.body: Accept aggregate-green draft CI because drafts are unmergeable and promotion triggers fresh macOS validation.

options.title: Preserve Full-Green Semantics
options.body: Retain macOS validation for drafts so every aggregate-green result always represents completed platform testing.

recommendation.title: Approve Draft Deferral
recommendation.body: Accept aggregate-green draft CI because drafts are unmergeable and promotion triggers fresh macOS validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision changes repository-wide CI semantics and hosted macOS runner allocation.
